name: Gorgeous Dream
overview: Labeled as tainted after four years in prison, Shen Wanqing is destroyed by the Liu family to protect their reputation. Reborn with a new face as Lan Mengyan, she marries into the Liu household to seek revenge, drawing both father and son into her trap. But as her plan places her in growing danger, the mysterious Qin Moxiu—who has been watching from the shadows—steps in.
